features.feature: 流程事实双层契约原则写入权威文档与 reviewer 通用 prompt
features.source: CHK-001 defines Process Fact Contract across CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, story-lifecycle.md, and reviewer prompts.

features.feature: reviewer prompt 与 CLI schema 漂移审计
features.source: CHK-002 adds test:process-fact-contract to scan reviewer prompts for illegal categories, pass-only finding_add, and plain passed evidence.

features.feature: finding_add / review_pass_set 等 reviewer 事实入口的兼容、归一与拒绝策略
features.source: CHK-003 covers pass-only finding_add conversion, legacy category normalization, and ambiguous pass text staying as findings.

features.feature: 流程事实与普通说明性文案边界
features.source: CHK-001 limits the principle to process facts; CHK-002 prevents plain prompt text becoming evidence.

features.feature: 非 finding 流程执行/确认入口 inventory：phase advance、review_pass_set、verification_evidence_add、delivery_check_set、scope_check_save、init_check_set 等
features.source: CHK-004 inventories phase/review/finding/evidence/init/scope/delivery entries and classifies each as hard guard, normalization, signature, rejection, or explicit defer.
